searchText: Staking rewards are high until enough validators are online, and then taper off, but there's no cutoff. Has any desired max amount of validators been discussed? I assume 100 million locked eth would be considered a failure. Probably also 50? 30..? Yes. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/2137 Just one possible solution, but there has been some thinking done on the subject.
